subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

BUP_ESH_UPL_SHB_PLES_BU_LE_H
solution:
Given : BUP_ESH_UPL_SHB_PLES_BU_LE_H 

By checking options :

 
• LBEHUSP → BUP__L__ESH / __B__UPL__E__SH / B**__H__**PLES**__U / __**BU**__S__**LE**__P__**H → (It doesn't Follows the pattern) 
 
• LBEUHPS → BUP__**L**__ESH / __**B**__UPL__**E**__SH / B__**U**__PLES__**H / **__BU__**P**__LE**__S__**H → (It follows the pattern of : BUPLESH - BUPLESH - BUPLESH - BUPLESH) 
 
• LBEUPSH → BUP__L__ESH / __B__UPL__E__SH B__U__PLES**__P / __**BU**__S__**LE__D__H → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• LBEPUSH → BUP__L__ESH / __B__UPL__E__SH / B**__P__**PLES**__U / __**BU**__S__**LE**__H__**H → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (2) gives the pattern of "BUP__L__ESH - __B__UPL__E__SH - B__U__PLES__H__ - BU__P__LE__S__H"

Hence, "**LBEUHPS**" is the correct answer.
